transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me. As you know, we're reviewing the proposed eighth-grade makerspace program before I make a final authorization decision. I'd like to hear from each of you on the implementation aspects relevant to your roles so I can make an informed decision. Let's start with you — what do we need to consider?

transcript.text: I need to flag an important safety concern. I completed my room-safety review this week, and it found that the makerspace may enroll no more than 16 students.
